limits: Edges are syntactic references. A trigger dispatching through custom metadata (TDTM and similar) reaches its handler with no reference to follow, so those edges are absent unless a coverage run revealed them.
This is reachability, not test selection. It must not be used to decide which tests to skip.
A coverage map was found, but it revealed no edges beyond the syntactic ones — either the dispatch gap is genuinely empty here, or the map is stale. Refresh it with `nimbus test "*" --coverage`.
Label edges cover Apex only — references from Flows, LWC, Aura and formulas are not read, so an unreferenced label means unreferenced from Apex, not safe to delete.
Scoped to Capacity_Disclaimer at depth 1 — this is a neighbourhood, not the whole project.
